name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia kills 2 on 24 Nov; 9 killed and 77 hurt across Ukraine in a day, officials say
state: A Russian night strike on Zaporizhzhia on 24 Nov killed two civilians and wounded 44, including four children, and partly destroyed a five-storey block (AP). Local authorities reported 9 killed and 77 injured across Ukraine that day, after a 19–20 Nov attack of 84 cruise missiles, 27 ballistic missiles and 404 drones that damaged three Kyiv bridges and killed at least nine (Kyiv Independent). Russia said it downed 699 Ukrainian drones overnight to 24 Nov; the UN puts civilian deaths since February 2022 at close to 18,000. Mass strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine and Russia's border regions is advised against by the FCDO; check its travel advice. Expect continued disruption to Ukrainian power, heating and water after strikes, and flight restrictions at Moscow airports during drone attacks.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty strikes — 84 cruise and 27 ballistic missiles plus 404 drones on 19–20 Nov; 9 killed, 77 hurt on 24 Nov
